methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents deliberate institutional capacity-building outside major metros, signaling potential for distributed deep capability if the lab produces genuine fluency rather than surface-level familiarity.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's AI Ready RVA partnership embedding AI education across community institutions could catalyze peer-learning networks beyond traditional tech hubs, testing whether regional anchor institutions can distribute deep capability.

signals.title: Meta, Google invest in skilled worker training to build Virginia data centers - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Meta and Google investing in skilled worker training specifically for Virginia data centers signals deepening technical capability, but concentrated in infrastructure-rich regions where hyperscalers locate—reinforcing geographic clustering of expertise.

signals.title: How are AI use and policy changing in schools? New VCU research identifies key gaps - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU research identifying gaps in school AI policy suggests emerging statewide adoption but reveals shallow implementation—schools consuming AI tools without developing institutional fluency or strategic frameworks for capability-building.

signals.title: To defend your software, first teach AI to break it - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech research on AI-driven software security represents deep technical capability generation, but concentrated in R1 university settings—advancing frontier knowledge that may not transfer to broader workforce without intentional distribution mechanisms.
